chapters.title: What is Long, What is Round?

cards.front: Which one can roll: a ball or a book?
Which one can slide but not roll: a brick or a bangle?
cards.explain: Flat sides slide. Round edges roll.

cards.front: Is a pencil long or round?
cards.explain: A pencil is long and thin.

cards.front: Which shape has no corners?
cards.explain: A circle is round all the way.

cards.front: Can a coin roll?
cards.explain: Stand a coin on its edge and it rolls.

3 tens and 4 ones make which number?
What is 10 more than 26?
What is the opposite of big?
cards.explain: An elephant is big. An ant is small.

cards.front: What is the opposite of hot?
cards.explain: Tea is hot. Ice is cold.

cards.front: What is the opposite of up?
cards.explain: The kite goes up. The ball comes down.

cards.front: What is the opposite of happy?
What is the opposite of day?
Find the naming word: The cat sleeps.
cards.explain: A naming word names a person, place, animal or thing.

cards.front: Find the naming word: Riya runs fast.
cards.explain: Riya is the name of a person.
